# Luxembourg Tech School (LTS)

> Luxembourg Tech School is a free after-school educational program for students aged 12-19 in Luxembourg. Founded in 2016, LTS teaches coding, game development, AI, FinTech, cybersecurity and more through a unique project-based methodology with personalised coaching.

## Organisation Details

- Legal name: Luxembourg Tech School Asbl
- Short name: LTS

- Email: info@techschool.lu
- Phone: +352 28 81 66 01
- Address: Luxembourg City Incubator, 9 rue du Laboratoire, L-1911 Luxembourg
- Founded: 2016
- Status: ASBL recognised as public interest organisation
- Language: English (primary)

## Programs Offered

LTS offers a 3-year program:
- Level G0: For ages 12-14. Introduction to Creative Coding and computers through playful, hands-on projects.
- Level One: For ages 15-18. Game Development, FinTech, AI and more — project-based with teamwork and entrepreneurship.
- Level Up: Continuation of Level One. Advanced modules including Space technology, cybersecurity and digital leadership.

All programs are free, last one full academic year (September to July), and take place once a week in partner schools across Luxembourg.
